crossrefs.anchor: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, consider carefully what is set before you,
and put a knife to your throat if you possess a great appetite.
Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.
Do not wear yourself out to get rich
be wise enough to restrain yourself
When you glance at
wealth, it disappears
it makes wings for itself and flies like an eagle to the sky
stingy man
do not crave
for he is keeping track, inwardly counting the cost
“Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you
Do not speak to a fool
he will despise the wisdom of your words
Do not move an ancient boundary stone
the fields of the fatherless
for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you
Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge
Do not withhold discipline from a child; although you strike him with a rod, he will not die
Strike him with a rod, and you will deliver his soul from Sheol
My son
if your heart is wise, my own heart will indeed rejoice
my own heart
your lips speak what is right
Do not let your heart envy sinners
always continue in the fear of the LORD
For surely
there is a future
your hope will not be cut off
guide your heart on the right course
Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat
the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty
drowsiness will clothe them in rags
Listen to your father who gave you life
do not despise your mother when she is old
Invest in truth
never sell it
The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice
will delight in him
may she who gave you birth rejoice
give me your heart
let your eyes delight in my ways
For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
Like a robber she lies in wait
multiplies the faithless among men
Who has woe? Who has sorrow?
bloodshot eyes
Those who linger over wine
mixed drinks
Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
In the end
bites like a snake
viper
strange things
your mind will utter perversities
You will be like one sleeping on the high seas
high seas
“They struck me
but I feel no pain
to search for another drink

evidence.text: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.
